Anyone under 13 should not be in VRChat. It's not just TOS, but also the law. It's the same reason why Facebook was going to drop Rec Room. 
I agree with you that some worlds may need to be labeled NSFW, but there are thousands if not hundreds of thousands of worlds to individually check. Not all worlds are very well known either. The simple solution is to give World creators a check box for NSFW, like they do for avatars, and an option to give those labels to previously uploaded worlds.
I also think that an icon or some public info should be present to inform other user's that a user is between 13-18. Having this would negate ignorance as an excuse for acting inappropriately towards someone who is not yet considered to be an adult. I am aware that some countries have different ages that are considered to be an adult. However, VRChat resides with in The United States of America, and has to abide by the laws within. When I mentioned this years ago, people mentioned "ageism" where user's would be discriminated against for having an under age icon. etc. etc. Mind you this was before the ranking system, and some people did get upset over that. However, I feel having this information is important. Not just for the person who is under aged, but also for the people who are not.
I also agree and would like to see an option for under age reporting. In which with enough reporting gives the accused user "Nuisance" role, and an inability to interact with people, and possibly worlds, until their age or circumstance is confirmed. Many users already know to block individuals with this role. Most children with a Nuisance role, with the effects mentioned, are too impatient to just create another account, or appeal to VRC to have the role removed. 
I don't think labeling worlds as "kid friendly" will help the situation, but exacerbate it. It's like saying, "kids are OK here" when in the TOS and by law, it is not. I'd also like to tell these kids parents that VR is not a substitute for a babysitter, and basic adulting and parenting is needed.

This is an extremely complex issue that doesn't have a foolproof solution.
"I suggest your staff labels certain worlds manually as kids friendly or specially made for kids and lock every other world behind a age wall of 18+"
Labelling a world as kid-friendly will (a) make kids not want to go there, and (b) become a target for unsavory characters. Labelling a world as 18+ or adult-only will make kids want to gain access to those worlds even more. 
"Let us report people that are underage using a adult labeled account."
How do you prove that someone is under the age of 18? How do you successfully label an account as being owned by an adult? Circumvention of age-gates has been a thing on the internet for nearly three decades now.
I'd like to clarify that I'm not against creating more adult-exclusive zones within VRChat, but I feel like the base game itself is as it should be: 13+. With the new Groups system coming out, that'll most likely be the best way to deal with the >18 issue.

You 100% are informed that on your platform things happen that are not by the biggest stretch of the imagination are meant to be consumed by anyone under 18.
I suggest your staff labels certain worlds manually as kids friendly or specially made for kids and lock every other world behind a age wall of 18+ for example FBT Heaven which is a strip club where kids currently can join when ever they feel like it, i know crazy right? They exist for ages and still no action being taken.
I do not say remove FBT heaven don't miss use what I am saying here, I say make a restriction so only people over the age of 18 can go there.
Do not ask for ID confirmation,  this will majorly effect your income and would be too much.
Let us report people that are underage using a adult labeled account.
Also fix your vote kicking system, majority of the time it doesn't work.
Thanks for reading this, I am not a god overlord and will provide you every single answer but take this as a idea to do better in the future.
